description: Connect Flickr to automate images and design, social media workflows.

flickr_group_photo_trigger.description: Runs when new photo in group appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

parameters.description: Group ID to watch.
parameters.name: group_id

flickr_matching_photo_trigger.description: Runs when new matching public photo appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

parameters.description: Search text to watch.
parameters.name: text

flickr_public_photo_trigger.description: Runs when new public photo by person appears after the initial complete scan. Polls at your plan interval; updates between polls may be combined. Watches at most 4,000 records.

parameters.description: Flickr user ID to watch.
parameters.name: person_id
